sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Stamp It Puzzle lies its core gameplay mechanics. The game revolves around controlling a cube stamp to collect ink and stamp passports with precision. The game is played on a grid-based board, where you'll need to navigate the cube stamp through a series of obstacles and challenges to reach the ink and stamp the passport. The cube stamp can move in four directions - left, right, up, and down - using the corresponding arrow keys.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter various obstacles and challenges that will require you to think strategically and use your logic skills to overcome. The levels will get progressively harder, introducing new obstacles and challenges that will test your skills and patience. With each level, you'll earn points and badges, which can be used to unlock new levels, power-ups, and other rewards.

One of the standout features of Stamp It Puzzle is its intuitive controls. The game is easy to learn, but challenging to master, making it perfect for players of all ages and skill levels.
